title: Anion-Manipulated Hydrolysis Process Assembles of Giant High-Nucleation Lanthanide-Oxo Cluster

synthesis.procedure: Combine o-vanillin, 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-diamine, DyCl3·6H2O, methanol, acetonitrile, and triethylamine in a Pyrex tube. Shake and sonicate for 5 min, seal, heat at 80 °C for three days, and slowly cool to room temperature to obtain yellow crystals.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling to room temperature; yellow lumpy crystals

properties.summary: Frequency-dependent AC susceptibility under zero DC field indicates single-molecule magnet behavior, with shifting out-of-phase peaks. Weak butterfly-like hysteresis was observed at 2 K.

synthesis.procedure: Follow the procedure for cluster 1, replacing its methanol/acetonitrile solvent mixture with 2 mL methanol. material_class.structural_family: Dy24 hydroxo/oxo cluster assembled from eight triangular Dy3 motifs

synthesis.procedure: Follow the procedure for cluster 1, replacing DyCl3·6H2O with Dy(OAc)3·6H2O. Combine it with o-vanillin, 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-diamine, methanol, acetonitrile, and triethylamine in a Pyrex tube; shake and sonicate for 5 min, seal and heat at 80 °C for three days, then slowly cool to room temperature.

reagents.name: Dy(OAc)3·6H2O
reagents.amount: 0.2 mmol (inherited from the shared cluster 1 procedure)

properties.summary: Zero-field, frequency-dependent AC susceptibility indicates single-molecule magnet behavior, although the out-of-phase signal lacks a distinct peak, attributed by the authors to possible quantum tunneling. Essentially no hysteresis was observed at 2 K.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An inner Dy6(OH)8 core comprises two oppositely oriented triangular Dy3 units; six further triangular Dy3 units surround it in a noncoplanar peripheral arrangement. The article proposes, rather than directly observes, a stepwise assembly through Dy3 and Dy6 motifs.
